text:
alex: Heads up — found ~18k GPU hours in asia-east project `sandbox-hackathon` that weren't tagged to any cost center. Need retro allocation before EOM billing. cc @maria @ben
maria: Ugh, thanks. Do you have the billing export rows (project id + sku + usage hours)? We need exact lines to create the journal entry.
alex: Pasting quick csv lines from billing export:
```
project_id,sku_description,usage_hours,cost
sandbox-hackathon,nvidia-a100-hours,11800,35400
sandbox-hackathon,nvidia-t4-hours,6200,9300
```
(estimate, full export attached to ticket I'm about to open)
cloud-billing-bot: Alert: budget threshold breached for billing_account: BA-132 (asia-east GPUs) — current month 112% of forecast :warning:
ben: Do we treat this as Platform Innovations (internal R&D) spend or distribute to customers who ran experiments? Who owned the runs?
tia: Ops note — most sandbox projects default to 'unallocated' when user onboarding misses `cost_center` tag. We should backfill tags from git repo ownership (owner email), but that's a separate ETL job.
raj: Can we split 70/30 (Platform Innovations / Product Experiments) based on run metadata? If so finance can post two journal entries and adjust internal budgets.
maria: Okay. For the retrocharge: finance needs (1) project id, (2) export lines, (3) suggested allocation percentages, (4) approval from owning PM. Ben can you confirm PM approval and attach a brief note for audit?
ben: Confirmed — PM @leila approved reassigning 70% -> Platform Innovations, 30% -> Product Experiments. I'll add her note to the ticket.
alex: Also flagging that ~65% of hours were spot. We should consider adjusting budget alerts to separate spot vs reserved to prevent false positives. Suggestion: add alert rule that excludes `preemptible` SKU from hard budget alarm and routes to ops channel instead.
tia: I'll file INFRA-962 to enforce `cost_center` at project creation and a backfill job (Airflow DAG) to patch existing resources. ETA 2 weeks for backfill run.
maria: Financial actions: I'll create journal FIN-5421 to apportion costs and post adjustment to March close. Ben, add PM approval. Alex, attach full billing export CSV in the ticket.
ben: Done. Ticket FIN-5421 created, linked to infra task INFRA-962. :white_check_mark:
alex: Thanks all. Follow-up: can we kick off a weekly untagged-project report to catch these earlier? small script or BigQuery scheduled query would work.
tia: Yep — scheduling weekly query, will share SQL in #eng-infra next week.
maria: Closing loop — retro allocation scheduled for EOM batch, finance will notify owners once entries posted. :heavy_check_mark:
